# Tender Response -- KMK-2026-03

Visakoivu Oy is pleased to submit this response to the invitation for technical maintenance services for the Koskimyllyn Kiinteistot portfolio.

## 3. Eligibility

Visakoivu holds a valid LUSA qualification for the relevant trades, together with NMSB 7310 (quality), NMSB 74210 (environment), NMSB 75310 (occupational health and safety) and NMSB 78410 (energy management) certification. Visakoivu's turnover comfortably exceeds the EUR 5,000,000 threshold set out in Section 3.2.

## 4. Technical proposal

Documentation and the asset register will be handed over at contract start and kept current in the usual way.

Proposed service levels: emergency faults, 4-hour response; urgent faults, 24-hour response; routine work, completion within 5 working days.

Building envelope condition (roofing, facades, windows) is inspected annually by walkthrough, supplemented by thermal imaging of the facades.

After any equipment replacement or repair, work is commissioned and tested against our standard sign-off procedure before handover to the client.

Warranty period on installed equipment and replacement parts: 24 months, parts and labour.

## 5. Commercial terms

Invoicing: monthly, by e-invoice.

Proposed contract period: 3 years, with two 1-year extension options.

## 6. Submission

The completed Tender Form (Appendix 1) is attached. Pricing is quoted in EUR/m2/year, per property, as required.

## Annex A

Occupational safety plan (A.1) is attached. Spare parts availability and delivery times (A.2) are described in the attached note. CVs of the proposed key personnel (A.3) are attached.
